item.title: Olivia Rodrigo and Yungblud Join Smashing Pumpkins for Surprise Lollapalooza Set
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update! We're coming to you live from the world of Billboard, where the Smashing Pumpkins just made history with their Lollapalooza headline set.
[Short music transition]
Host: The Chicago-bred band took the stage in their hometown, marking their first Lollapalooza headlining slot in 32 years. And what a night it was! Billy Corgan brought out two surprise guests, Olivia Rodrigo and Yungblud, to perform some nineties deep cuts.
[Clip of "Luna" or "Thirty-Three" plays in the background]
Host: Yungblud joined Corgan on stage to sing "Luna" from the Pumpkins' 1993 album Siamese Dream. And then, Olivia Rodrigo took the stage to perform "Thirty-Three" from the 1995 album Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness. These pairings were more than just a musical match-up - they represented a lineage of alternative rock that the Smashing Pumpkins helped pave the way for.
[Short music transition]
Host: Both Rodrigo and Yungblud have been influenced by the nineties alt-rock sound, and it was amazing to see them share the stage with one of the genre's pioneers. The Smashing Pumpkins' Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness remains one of the band's most iconic albums, debuting at number one on the Billboard 200 in 1995 and certified diamond by the RIAA.
[Clip of "1979" or "Bullet With Butterfly Wings" plays in the background]
Host: And what a legacy the album has left! With hits like "1979" and "Bullet With Butterfly Wings", it's no wonder the Pumpkins are still rocking out today. We'll have to see what's next for this iconic band, but for now, it's clear that their music still resonates with fans of all ages.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's update. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!
